verdict.rationale: YPOG's own site documents cross-border venture matters. These include advising Langdock on relocating its registered seat to Germany with an SE holding structure (a redomiciliation) and Isembard on its German market entry. It also runs a 'Venture Deals in Germany' guide comparing German terms to other jurisdictions and covering the FDI regime, and offers English-language notarizations. Missing for 10: detailed case write-ups beyond headline mentions, explicit evidence of multi-jurisdiction financing rounds or international investor representation, outbound or US-flip work, and independent corroboration.
